title: setTargetAPY settles prior accrual using current totalStaked, mispricing pre-setter period if an emergencyWithdraw has shrunk totalStaked since lastRewardTime
asset_impact: Child of DEDUP-002: minor amplification of over-emission at the APY-change boundary.
attack_path:
1. Alice and Bob stake at t=0 (totalStaked=20).
2. Bob emergencyWithdraws at t=100 without _updatePool running.
3. Owner calls setTargetAPY at t=150; _updatePool uses elapsed=150 but totalStaked=10, over-crediting Alice for the [0,100] window.
4. Fix is the same as DEDUP-002: call _updatePool inside emergencyWithdraw.
likelihood: low - only manifests when an emergencyWithdraw has occurred and no _updatePool has fired since.
assumptions: Owner changes APY while totalStaked has shrunk since lastRewardTime.
justification: State-handling / spec deviation; subordinate to DEDUP-002. No independent attack path. C4 Low.
